newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Bank Negara down on disappointing results.
newsitem.headline: Bank Negara down on disappointing results.

text.p: Shares of state-controlled PT Bank Negara Indonesia eased in active trading on Wednesday because many investors were disappointed with its 1996 net results, brokers said.

On Tuesday, the bank announced unaudited 1996 net profit of 335 billion rupiah, compared with a consensus estimate of 324.6 billion rupiah, but brokers said some investors felt the figure was below expectations.
Bank BNI was the most active stock with 12.6 million shares traded, falling 50 rupiah to 1,600 rupiah in morning trade after touching a low of 1,575 rupiah.
"Actually, the results were in line with market expectations but many investors expected some surprise," Kian Guntur, a broker of Schroeders Indonesia, said.
Brokers said disappointment over BNI had dampened market sentiment on other banking stocks.
Bank International Indonesia, Bank Danamon Lippo Bank and Bank BDNI were among the targets of sellers, brokers said.
